programme.title: The Da Vinci Code
programme.desc: A dying curator of the Louvre hides cryptic clues on Da Vinci paintings. Now it is up to Robert Langdon and Sophie Neveu to follow the clues and unearth a secret kept hidden for centuries.

programme.title: Resident Evil: Apocalypse
programme.desc: Alice wakes up to find that Raccoon city is infested with zombies and monsters. Later, she tries her best to find a way out of the city before it is too late.

programme.title: Resident Evil
programme.desc: Two associates of an elite commando team fight an army of zombies controlled by an evil desktop computer in a genetic research facility.

programme.title: Don't Breathe
programme.desc: Three delinquents break into the house of Norman, a Gulf War veteran who is visually impaired, to steal his money. However, they discover that Norman is not as helpless as he seems.

programme.title: Charlie's Angels: Full Throttle
programme.desc: The Angels track down rings containing the names of those in the FBI's witness protection programme. However, the witnesses begin to get murdered one by one.

programme.title: Ghostbusters
programme.desc: When Peter Venkman, Raymond Stantz and Egon Spengler lose their jobs as scientists, they start an establishment called Ghostbusters to fight the evil ghosts lurking in New York City.

programme.title: Men in Black 3
programme.desc: Agent J of the Men in Black goes back in time to prevent the assassination of his partner, Agent K, at the hands of an alien criminal named Boris the Animal.

programme.title: Welcome to the Jungle
programme.desc: A group of co-workers embark on a team-building exercise on an uninhabited island. However, when their ex-marine guide is killed, they are left stranded and must struggle to survive.

programme.title: Ghostbusters: Frozen Empire
programme.desc: The Spengler family must join forces with the original Ghostbusters to stop an ancient evil force from refreezing the world, whilst protecting their iconic New York City firehouse headquarters.

programme.title: Blade Runner 2049
programme.desc: K, an officer with the Los Angeles Police Department, unearths a secret that could create chaos. He goes in search of a former Blade Runner who has been missing for over three decades.

programme.title: Uncharted
programme.desc: Recruited by Victor, street-smart Nathan steps into a race for the lost treasure of Ferdinand Magellan. However, a corrupt billionaire and an evil mercenary also have the same goal.

programme.title: Materialists
programme.desc: A young and ambitious New York City matchmaker finds herself torn between a seemingly perfect match and her imperfect ex-boyfriend.

programme.title: Spider-Man: Into the Spider-Verse
programme.desc: Miles Morales begins his new life as Spider-Man after receiving a spider bite. However, things take a strange twist when he meets alternate versions of himself from other universes.

programme.title: Escape Room: Tournament of Champions
programme.desc: Ben and Zoey find themselves trapped in a series of deadly escape rooms with four others. They try to survive and find a way out as they slowly discover that they have played the game before.

programme.title: Insidious: Chapter 3
programme.desc: Quinn, a young girl, reaches out to a powerful psychic to help her contact her recently deceased mother. However, her plan backfires when an evil spirit makes Quinn a host and hurts her physically.

programme.title: Lake Placid vs. Anaconda
programme.desc: A genetically modified anaconda and a giant crocodile escape captivity and enter a nearby lake. When the two massive creatures fight, the sheriff tries to prevent the town from being destroyed.

programme.title: The Equalizer 3
programme.desc: As Robert McCall finds himself forming a new bond with the locals of an Italian town, the region's oppression by the Mafia triggers him to protect his people.

programme.title: Sisu
programme.desc: As WWII comes to an end, Aatami Korpi trudges towards retirement with a bag full of gold. However, when a Nazi soldier learns about the treasure, he chases after the warrior, unaware of his prowess.

programme.title: Stuart Little
programme.desc: Upon getting adopted by the Littles, Stuart, a mouse, is unwelcomed by his new brother George. So, when Stuart begins to feel low the family helps him find his real parents.

programme.title: Cloudy With a Chance of Meatballs
programme.desc: A diligent scientist invents an innovative machine that drops food from the sky to help his fellow residents. Chaos ensues when the machine becomes uncontrollable.

programme.title: XXX: State of the Union
programme.desc: Darius Stone, a former US Navy SEAL, is recruited as a new agent in the XXX program to stop a rogue military faction from overthrowing the US government.

programme.title: Spider-Man: Homecoming
programme.desc: Peter Parker tries to stop the Vulture from selling weapons made with advanced Chitauri technology while trying to balance his life as an ordinary high school student.

programme.title: Harold and the Purple Crayon
programme.desc: Harold's drawings spring to life when he ventures into the real world. His purple crayon accidentally creates challenges and he and his friends must safeguard both worlds.

programme.title: Bring Her Back
programme.desc: Andy and his sister Piper face unsettling events while living with their foster mother Laura, whose grief and secrets draw them into a chilling supernatural ordeal.

programme.title: Once Upon a Time... In Hollywood
